intent: Pick a value or range along a track. One piece. Range is a two-value array, not a RangeSlider cousin.
useWhen: Adjust a numeric setting on a continuous scale
Pick a min and max range for filters
Volume, brightness, or percent controls in a form
doNotUseWhen: Discrete choices from a short list — use RadioGroup or Select

labelledBy.note: Id(s) of the visible label for each thumb's aria-labelledby. Field passes its label id, so a Slider inside Field is named by the Field label.

describedBy.note: Id(s) for each thumb's aria-describedby. Field passes its hint or error id.

error.note: Marks each thumb aria-invalid. Field sets it when it has an error.

value.note: Current value. Single number for one thumb. Two numbers for a range.

orientation.note: Vertical is orientation, not a VerticalSlider cousin.

onValueChange.note: Called with the next value or value array.

requirements: Each thumb has role=slider and an accessible name: aria-label, aria-labelledby, or the Field label via labelledBy
describedBy and error land on each thumb (aria-describedby, aria-invalid)
aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow on each thumb
Arrow keys adjust by step. Home and End jump to min and max

doNot: Do not invent SliderTrack, SliderThumb, SliderRange, RangeSlider, or VerticalSlider
Do not use a native range input
snippet:
<Field label="Volume" htmlFor="volume">
  <Slider id="volume" value={33} onValueChange={setValue} />
</Field>
<Slider aria-label="Price range" value={[25, 75]} onValueChange={setRange} />
<Slider aria-label="Level" value={50} orientation="vertical" disabled />
